text: Theorem 6.1 (completeness) states that if the depth-d, width-q decomposition is A-provable and rho-stable with probability 1-gamma over inputs, there is a prover strategy A in the class such that, for every estimator B of any size, with probability at least 1-2gamma the expected payoff to A is at least 1/rho^(d+1), with the expectation over the protocol's internal randomness.
title: Theorem 6.1 completeness: honest prover with a stable decomposition beats any estimator
